coverage: Only the exact evaluated template Action releases a controller.
Candidate Signal event time must be strictly later than evaluation time.
Offset-bearing timestamps compare as instants on D1/SQLite and PostgreSQL.
Equal or malformed timestamps fail closed to suppression without throwing.
Concurrent same-cycle writes produce one active successor and no orphan graph rows.
A same-millisecond losing writer cannot reuse another write's release marker.
A PostgreSQL terminal Run transition cannot land between controller release and successor creation.
Legacy controller adoption cannot override an active normalized ledger controller.
